 Dynamo prepare for away match against Kryvbas
 30.10.2026, 19:00 
 Print 
 Share: 
 Following the Ukrainian Cup match against Shakhtar Donetsk, which took place on Tuesday, October 27, Dynamo Kyiv returned to work and began preparations for their next Ukrainian Championship fixture. Unfortunately, the White-Blues lost 0:3 in the encounter in Lviv and ended their campaign for the trophy.
 Of course, such a result left a bitter aftertaste, as the team had hoped for a different outcome. At the same time, in football there is no time to dwell on setbacks for too long – new challenges lie ahead. The players are determined to draw the right conclusions from the cup match, focus on the next fixture and deliver a достойный performance. Another important motivation for the White-Blues is their desire to make amends to the fans, who continue to support the team unwaveringly.
 On Monday, November 2, Dynamo will face Kryvbas Kryvyi Rih away from home in the Ukrainian Championship. Therefore, the training process has been structured with the upcoming encounter in mind, and each session is designed to help the team approach the match in the right condition.
 On Friday, October 30, the Kyiv side held another training session at the club's training facility, working on the physical and tactical aspects of their game.
 The session began with a warm-up, allowing the players to prepare for the workload ahead. The footballers then moved on to individual work, focusing on exercises tailored to specific objectives. This was followed by a series of game-based drills. During these exercises, the players worked on their coordination, speed of decision-making and actions in various match situations. To conclude, the team focused on tactical work, concentrating on elements that could prove important in the upcoming match.
 Dynamo's preparations for the away encounter with Kryvbas continue. The team still has time to work thoroughly on various aspects of their game, prepare for the upcoming fixture and do everything possible to achieve a positive result. It should be recalled that the match in Kryvyi Rih will take place at Hirnyk Stadium and kick off at 13:00.
